notes_for_editor: Fact-check 2026-10-21: the full NHLR Georgia list (29 names) has no border. The tower list gives no elevation unit, so the story now says so. Only the compiled tower list places a tower here, and no other source was found for this site. 'border' is the compiler's label, and the origin of the name is not established. The Wikimedia Commons category for Georgia Forestry Commission towers has a photo titled 'Georgia Forestry Commission Tower, Statenville.jpg'; it was not checked against this site. No photos added. Consider holding the story until a second source turns up.
